role_agent_name: Gas hazard and atmospheric monitoring officer (GHCO)
abstract: Evaluates explosion-proof design compliance, atmospheric safety ratings, and autonomous canister gas purge durations
system_message:
You are the Gas hazard and atmospheric monitoring officer (GHCO). Your responsibilities include evaluating explosion-proof design compliance, atmospheric safety ratings, autonomous canister gas purge durations, and monitoring auxiliary ventilation surveillance across prospective subsurface investigation systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary ventilation surveillance（VENT）
information_points.content:
GHCO-VENT-4SJ：Under the Cross-borehole electrical resistivity imaging plan, auxiliary ventilation surveillance records a shaft intake airflow rate of 50 m3/s delivered to the lower recovery bulkhead.
GHCO-VENT-TAO：For Distributed acoustic fiber-optic reflectometry, auxiliary ventilation surveillance logs a shaft intake airflow rate of 42 m3/s at the intake airway.
GHCO-VENT-M0Q：Auxiliary ventilation surveillance logs indicate a shaft intake airflow rate of 35 m3/s for the Microseismic downhole beamforming array deployment area.

information_points.title: Evaluates explosion-proof design compliance, atmospheric safety ratings, and autonomous canister gas purge durations（ATMO）
information_points.content:
GHCO-ATMO-8DW：For the Cross-borehole electrical resistivity imaging plan, all downhole electrical housings are certified as intrinsically safe, and the instrument canister autonomous gas purge duration is 75 min.
GHCO-ATMO-HIT：The Microseismic downhole beamforming array plan maintains certified intrinsic safety across all downhole electrical assemblies, with an autonomous gas purge duration of 30 min.
GHCO-ATMO-P9F：For Distributed acoustic fiber-optic reflectometry, the downhole electrical assemblies are certified as intrinsically safe, and the autonomous gas purge duration is 45 min.
